pages.title: Nether
pages.text: $(bold)The Nether's ground: netherrack, nylium, basalt, blackstone, soul sand and soil, magma, quartz, glowstone, nether gold, nether wart and nether bricks. Needs Obsidian as well. With Nether Remastered, you must also have used a Seal of the Underworld.$(br2)$(thing)Diamond Age$(n), ring 6.$(br)$(thing)16 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Gold and Obsidian.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Use a Seal of the Underworld$(n)$(br2)Pays 2 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.

pages.title: Unlocks
pages.text: $(bold)netherrack, crimson nylium, warped nylium, basalt, polished basalt, blackstone, magma block, soul sand, soul soil, soul torch, soul lantern, soul campfire, nether quartz ore, quartz, glowstone, glowstone dust, nether gold ore, nether wart, nether brick.
